risk_note: RV2 money (apps/api/src/modules/payout/jobs/transfer-job.ts only): the fix of B2-06f money r4's out_of_scope S2 (ledger #1735, a launch gate before payout.enabled is turned on with real money). As soon as release() judges a payer-side result (payer_side_codes) or an unknown code that pauses, pauseAndAlert runs first. It sets the in-process mark (D10-404: the payout.queue_paused version read under the payout_daily lock), raises payout_queue_paused, and sends payout-landing/pause with trx:null; a failed send only warns and the mark stays. Only then come completeAttempt, the W9 payer_side_after_transfer or the first query, and none of the earlier steps is undone. A failing W9 or attempt write rejects for the queue to redeliver. On redelivery ② finds the recorded payer_side fail attempt and lands W9 on that transaction under a status / row_version CAS, with no query and no repeated alert or pause (the pause job is also deduplicated by singletonKey). A failed first-query send for an unknown code is tried once more on a fresh transaction. query-job.ts is unchanged (a query never pauses, BR-WDR-17). Rule tests by a fresh independent Claude (approvals #36), red PASS on the spec commit (4 red, all assertion failures). Implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent in one run. verify:fast in the test-machine container exit 0. Full verify on the test machine: full-1 lost its ssh connection five minutes in (Connection reset by peer, exit 2, no result); the queued re-run was withdrawn per the orchestrator (20:0x); landed with SKIP_VERIFY as B1-01zzp / B2-11d, CI verify-int is the check (D10-319).
